title: docs(skills): five skills follow-ups — audit sealing, compareTo date key, i18n wording, nested relation conditions

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuFzkfvSQAzUvfT2kjgBCmLC)_

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。对外发布的技能包里五处说法改成和已合入的平台一致：审计封存怎么切检查点、怎么验账；仪表盘同比环比的日期键要求；翻译技能里两句过时或像禁令的话；查询技能里关联条件现在能套三层、一千条上限只剩少数情况。另有三处代码注释改正谁挂载翻译接口。
- 为什么做：这些平台改动早已合入，技能包还在教旧说法，照着技能包干活的 AI 会写出被拒的仪表盘、低估查询能力、或以为不能手动注册翻译插件。
- 出错会怎样：只动教 AI 的文字和注释，没有行为变化；写错最多是 AI 学到一句不准的话，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无，座位复核后交审批人。

## What changes

Five published skill files, one eval case, three comments. No ceiling row moved: every added byte is paid by a deletion in the same file. All `skills/**` text was written by an isolated sub-agent served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`verify-review-tier.mjs` PASS, 102 turns).

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` § Sealing + eval case 16 of `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`** (#33773, matches `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` l.228-273 and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` `os audit verify`)

- A sealed hour is one checkpoint, or consecutive checkpoints of at most 10,000 rows, per organization chain (plus the chain of rows about no organization). Replaces "a chained checkpoint per organization".
- `chainField` (optional, default `tenant_id`) names the chain column; it is fixed once checkpoints exist (a change reads `listed_twice`). The parse refusal sentence now covers a chain column the object lacks or one that cannot name an organization, and absorbs the old one-line `❌ valueFields: ['created_at']` block.
- `os audit verify` exits 1 on a row changed outside the platform and on a chain fault (link, signature, `listed_twice`).
- Eval case 16 `expected_output` stops saying "one checkpoint per organization"; its `must_contain` set is unchanged and all present.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` § `compareTo`** (#34328, matches `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` "The Date Key of a Compare Widget")

- New **Date key** bullet: the window travels as a time dimension named after `dateRange.field` (default `created_at`), so the dataset declares a date dimension of that name, else `400 INVALID_FIELD` naming the remedy; a related-record date path is covered by a date dimension over it under any name. "No author-time check catches it yet" (the docs page still says so; #34308 is open).

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** (#38177, #37695 N2/N3 + its out-of-diff note)

- The aside "(The schema docstring mentions `{variable}` notation, but that is not what the runtime implements.)" is gone; in its place, activity-milestone summaries keep their authored `{field}` tokens (`translation.zod.ts`, `translations.mdx` l.82, l.526-528).
- "Don't wire this plugin" → "You do not need to wire this plugin" (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` auto-registers only when no i18n plugin is present).
- `getSourceLocale()` (the declared one only, else `undefined`) — `packages/spec/src/contracts/i18n-service.ts`.
- The routes are mounted "for signed-in callers", and the locales answer names the declared `fallbackChain`, if any (`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`).

**`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` + `rules/filters.md`** (#33875, matches `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` l.686-760)

- On `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate` a single-valued relation is one in-database subquery per relationship, no id list, no cap, on drivers declaring `DriverCapabilities.readableIdsLeaf`; MongoDB and OData refuse it `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 before reading.
- A relation key may carry its own condition, up to three relationships; a fourth and a dotted key inside are refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400.
- The 1000-id cap stays only where ids are read: a multi-valued relation, `update` / `delete`, and the docs' fallback cases (another datasource, federated, middleware/`afterFind`-shaped, different driver options).
- A related record the caller cannot read at any hop excludes the row, `$ne` included. "one level" / "up to 1000 related ids" are gone.

**Comments** (#37695 N1): `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (two docblocks), `i18n-resolver.test.ts` (two comments), `packages/client/src/index.ts` (one docblock) name the runtime HTTP dispatcher as the mounter; service-i18n's own routes were retired by #23347.

**One changeset** `.changeset/33773-skills-follow-merged-code-a.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Acceptance notes

- What paid the bytes (lossless unless noted): example objects folded to one line, comment alignment padding, table separator rows shortened, restating comments dropped. Lossy, each restated elsewhere: `filters.md` § Operator Reference is now one example per operator, without its Category and SQL-equivalent columns (`SKILL.md` **Filter Operators** carries purpose and SQL for all 19); `lifecycle.md` dropped "a regulated tenant sets `'2y'` while dev keeps days" and "invoices" from an example cell; `dashboards.md` lost its two-line `compareTo:` fragment block (the `dimension` example moved into the table row).
- No docs page changed: each one the cards name already reads true at 7605e0c9.
- No eval round was run.

Read first: `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` (the Limits paragraph is the densest rewrite), then `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` § Sealing.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → "61 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".

## Tests

Prose and comments only; no test behaviour changed, no ablation.

Local gates on head b27a9339 (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 106 commands; `--ran` reconciles 106 of 106):

<details><summary>104 exit 0 · 2 NOT MEASURED (local prerequisite missing) · CI runs the full farm</summary>

- 104 commands exit 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` ("61 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings"), `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`.

- NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3, reason: its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach ("Deepen the clone").
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, reason: it needs a full `pnpm build` ("This is NOT a pass: nothing was measured"); the diff touches only comments in `packages/spec` and `packages/client`.
- Eval fixture: no repo script validates `skills/*/evals/*.json`; the file parses, `loadSkillEvalCatalog('skills')` loads it, and `test/skill-evals` in `packages/qa/scenarios` passes 38/38.

</details>

## Review round 1 (contract review 7235538894 on b27a9339) → head baf48948

- S1 `lifecycle.md` § Sealing: "exits 1 on a row edited, inserted or deleted outside the platform" → "(read-only) exits with code 1 on a changed, missing or unsealed row or a chain fault (a link, a signature, a row `listed_twice`)". An inserted row is `late` and unsealed only until `sealLate` seals it (`sealer.ts`, 7-day horizon); `cli.mdx` exit code 1 is the source.
- N1 `filters.md`: "narrower than the rest of the table" → "narrower than the other operators'"; `query/SKILL.md`: "Full table, `$like` portability…" → "All examples, `$like` portability…" (the full table now lives in `SKILL.md`).
- N2 eval case 16: "a chain fault" → "a chain fault such as a row `listed_twice`".
- N3 `i18n/SKILL.md`: → "A milestone summary (`_milestones.<field>.<value>.summary`) keeps its single-brace `{field}` tokens." (path notation of `translations.mdx` l.82; the `objects.<name>.` prefix left out for the ceiling).
- N4 `i18n-resolver.ts`: the `ResolvedFieldLabel` docblock's tense is one story now ("the branch the dispatcher checks first (as service-i18n's route did)").
- Same writer split: skills text by the isolated sub-agent (`verify-review-tier.mjs` PASS, 110 turns), N4 by the thread. Every skills file still ends exactly at its unchanged ceiling; bundle 303363 → 303370 (+7, eval fixture). Re-run on the new tree, each exit 0: `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-skill-links`, `check-skill-identifier-liveness`, `check-skill-examples` (351), `build-skill-docs --check`, `build-skill-references --check`, `check:nul-bytes`.
